mission_goal: 用 tkc:oss-lbm:kruger-poiseuille-bb-exactness-scope 的 contested 适用范围判据设计并执行 half-way bounce-back Poiseuille 宽度扫描，检验「精确解」是否只在部分宽度成立

knowledge_used.statement: The documented exactness of the half-way bounce-back Poiseuille solution at tau = sqrt(3/16) + 0.5 was reproduced only for part of the tested channel widths: a line-by-line NumPy port reaches L2 = 7.6e-16 at NY = 5 and 6.8e-13 at NY = 15, but 4.0e-3 at NY = 10 and 1.1e-3 at NY = 20 (u_max = 0.1/scale, tau fixed), so as an unrestricted statement it is not supported by this evidence.

experiment.scheme: force-driven Guo + half-way bounce-back + full D2Q9 equilibrium (the claim's port used PBBC + linear equilibrium)

verdict_basis: worst relative L2 over the sweep < 3% under the force-driven scheme; the claim's PBBC-only restriction is therefore scheme-specific, not a property of the magic tau
honesty_note: This is NOT a replication of the claim's L2 numbers (different hydrodynamic boundary condition + equilibrium); it is a scope probe.
knowledge_effect: the contested claim changed the conclusion from 'exact everywhere' to 'exact under this scheme; the reported limitation is setup-specific', and the control shows a naive tau fails >15%
